title: Dugoff Wheel 2DOF
text: Dugoff Wheel 2DOF 车轮，带盘式制动器、鼓式制动器或映射制动器，输入 11 路、输出 8 路；按 {Brake pad mean radius, Rm} 指定半径；{Tire type} 指定类型 User、{Model slip type}、{Brake type}、{Rolling Resistance} 指定滚动阻力转矩、{Vertical Motion} 指定 Vertical motion model、{Longitudinal stiffness, Ckappa} 指定 Longitudinal stiffness 1e7、{Lateral stiffness per slip angle, Calpha} 指定 Lateral stiffness 4.5e4、{Camber stiffness, Cgamma} 指定 Camber stiffness 1e3、{Maximum friction scaling coefficient, mu0}、{Friction reduction factor, As}、{Longitudinal relaxation length, Lrelx}、{Lateral relaxation length, Lrely}、{Longitudinal squared slip correction factor, gx1}、{Longitudinal squared slip friction correction factor, gx2} 指定纵向平方滑移摩擦修正因子、{Longitudinal linear slip correction factor, gx3} 指定纵向线性滑移修正因子、{Longitudinal linear slip friction correction factor, gx4} 指定纵向线性滑移摩擦修正因子、{Longitudinal offset correction factor, gx5} 指定纵向偏移修正因子、{Lateral maximum friction correction factor, gy1} 指定横向最大摩擦修正因子、{Lateral offset correction factor, gy2} 指定横向偏移修正因子、{Velocity independent force coefficient, aMy} 指定速度无关的力系数 84e-4、{Linear velocity force component, bMy} 指定线性速度力分量 6.2e-4、{Quadratic velocity force component, cMy} 指定二次速度力分量 1.6e-4、{Tire pressure exponent, alphaMy} 指定轮胎压力指数、{Normal force exponent, betaMy} 指定法向力指数、{Parasitic losses force, Fpl} 指定寄生力损失、{Rolling resistance constant, Cr} 指定滚动阻力常数 1e-3、{Thermal correction factor, Kt} 指定热修正因子、{Measured temperature, Tmeas} 指定测试期间温度、{Ambient temperature, Tamb} 指定应用环境中的温度、{Input ambient temperature} 指定输入环境温度、{Rolling resistance torque coefficient, QSY1} 指定扭矩系数、{Longitudinal force rolling resistance coefficient, QSY2} 指定力阻力系数、{Linear rotational speed rolling resistance coefficient, QSY3} 指定线性速度系数、{Quartic rotational speed rolling resistance coefficient, QSY4} 指定四次方速度系数 8.5e-05、{Camber squared rolling resistance torque, QSY5} 指定外倾阻力矩、{Load based camber squared rolling resistance torque, QSY6} 指定载荷阻力矩、{Normal load rolling resistance coefficient, QSY8} 指定法向阻力系数、{Pressure load rolling resistance coefficient, QSY8} 指定压力阻力系数、{Rolling resistance scaling factor, lam_My} 指定缩放因子、{Spin axis velocity breakpoints, VxMy} 指定自旋轴速度断点、{Normal force breakpoints, FzMy} 指定法向力断点、{Rolling resistance torque map, MyMap} 指定滚动阻力矩映射 array、{Tire nominal section width, WIDTH} 指定轮胎名义断面宽度 scalar、{Linear yaw rate resistance, bMz} 指定线性横摆角速度阻力、{Static friction coefficient, mu_static} 指定静摩擦系数、{Kinetic friction coefficient, mu_kinetic} 指定动摩擦、{Disc brake actuator bore, disc_abore} 指定缸径距离、{Number of brake pads, num_pads} 指定制动片数量、{Drum brake actuator bore, drum_abore} 指定缸径距离、{Shoe pin to drum center distance, drum_a} 指定制动蹄销到制动鼓中心的距离、{Shoe pin center to force application point distance, drum_c} 指定制动蹄销中心到力作用点的距离、{Drum internal radius, drum_r} 指定制动鼓内半径、{Shoe pin to pad start angle, drum_theta1} 指定制动蹄销到制动片起始角度、{Shoe pin to pad end angle, drum_theta2} 指定制动蹄销到制动片终止角度、{Brake actuator pressure breakpoints, brake_p_bpt} 指定制动器执行器压力断点 vector、{Wheel speed breakpoints, brake_n_bpt} 指定车轮速度断点 vector、{Brake torque map, f_brake_t} 指定制动扭矩查找表 array、{Rotational damping, br} 指定旋转阻尼 scalar、{Tire rotational inertia (rolling axis), IYY} 指定轮胎转动惯量 scalar、{Initial wheel rotational velocity, omegao} 指定初始车轮旋转速度 scalar、{Tire unloaded radius, UNLOADED_RADIUS} 指定轮胎无载半径、{Tire mass, MASS} 指定轮胎质量、{Initial tire displacement, zo} 指定轮胎初始位移、{Initial wheel vertical velocity (wheel fixed frame), zdoto} 指定车轮初始垂向速度、{Gravitational acceleration, GRAVITY} 指定重力加速度、{Vertical deflection breakpoints, zFz} 指定垂向变形断点、{Pressure breakpoints, pFz} 指定压力断点、{Force due to deflection, Fzz} 由变形产生的力、{Vertical velocity breakpoints, zdotFz} 指定垂向速度断点、{Force due to velocity, Fzzdot} 由速度产生的力、{Maximum normal force, FZMAX} 指定最大法向力、{Minimum normal force, FZMIN} 指定最小法向力、{Maximum pressure, PRESMAX} 指定最大压力、{Minimum pressure, PRESMIN} 指定最小压力、{Max allowable slip ratio (absolute), KPUMAX} 指定最大允许滑移率、{Minimum allowable slip ratio (absolute), KPUMIN} 指定最小允许滑移率、{Max allowable slip angle (absolute), ALPMAX} 指定最大允许侧偏角、{Minimum allowable slip angle (absolute), ALPMIN} 指定最小允许侧偏角、{Maximum allowable camber angle, CAMMAX} 指定最大允许外倾角、{Minimum allowable camber angle, CAMMIN} 指定最小允许外倾角、{Minimum ambient temperature, TMIN} 指定最低环境温度、{Maximum ambient temperature, TMAX} 指定最高环境温度、{Install Extended Tire Features} 用于安装 Extended Tire Features for Vehicle Dynamics Blockset™ 支持包、{Plot steady state force, moment response} 用于绘制稳态力和力矩轮胎响应的选项，按实例取值。
